summary: Ancient capital of 13 dynasties and start of the Silk Road. First-timers come for the Terracotta Army, the Ming city wall and the Muslim Quarter food lanes; Mount Hua is the big day trip. About 4–4.5 h by high-speed train from Beijing.

pitfalls.title: No Terracotta ticket
pitfalls.situation: Turning up without a real-name booking.
pitfalls.consequence: Turned away or stuck with touts; holidays sell out days ahead.
pitfalls.fix: Book on bmy.com.cn / official WeChat with your passport as soon as plans are firm.

pitfalls.title: Fake ticket sites
pitfalls.situation: Booking Terracotta tickets or tours via look-alike websites or social profiles.
pitfalls.fix: Only the official site/WeChat, or a known platform.

pitfalls.title: The fake Terracotta bus
pitfalls.situation: Uniformed touts at Xi'an Railway Station steer you to a private minibus.
pitfalls.consequence: Pay many times the fare and get detoured to replica factories or a 'fake warriors' museum.
pitfalls.fix: Metro Line 9 + bus, the plain public bus 306 (pay on board), or Didi.

pitfalls.title: Free museum, impossible ticket
pitfalls.situation: Shaanxi History Museum is free but tickets are released on a schedule and go in minutes.
pitfalls.consequence: Miss the best museum in the city.
pitfalls.fix: Set an alarm for the release time on the official WeChat account, or go with a guide who books it.

pitfalls.title: Xi'an North is far
pitfalls.situation: Booking a hotel or a tight connection assuming the station is central.
pitfalls.consequence: Lose 30–40 min each way; miss trains.
pitfalls.fix: Metro Line 2 to the center (~27 min); stay near North only for early trains.

pitfalls.title: Golden Week crush
pitfalls.situation: Visiting during National Day (1–7 Oct 2026) or other national holidays.
pitfalls.consequence: Terracotta hits capacity first; Huashan cable car queues ~3 h; taxis unreliable.
pitfalls.fix: Shift dates (late Sep or after 8 Oct), or book everything the day it opens and stay near the main sights.

pitfalls.title: Tourist prices on the main strip
pitfalls.situation: Eating only on Beiyuanmen, the main Muslim Quarter street.
pitfalls.fix: Walk one lane west to Xiyangshi (西羊市) and Dapiyuan (大皮院).

pitfalls.title: Halal outside the Quarter
pitfalls.situation: Ordering roujiamo or Han dishes elsewhere in the city.
pitfalls.consequence: Roujiamo is often pork; cooking wine is common and unmentioned.
pitfalls.fix: Eat halal in the Muslim Quarter or at restaurants with 清真 signs.

pitfalls.title: Mount Hua eats the whole day
pitfalls.situation: Planning Huashan as a casual half-day.
pitfalls.consequence: Miss the last train or turn back early; exhausting for weak knees; fog Jul–Aug hides the views.
pitfalls.fix: Early HSR, West Peak cable car up and North Peak down (~¥450–530 all-in); skip the plank walk if heights scare you.

pitfalls.title: Huashan's hidden costs
pitfalls.consequence: Mandatory shuttle (~¥40 each way) and cable cars triple the cost.

pitfalls.title: Wall bike rules
pitfalls.situation: Planning to cycle the wall with kids or older parents, or arriving late.
pitfalls.consequence: Rental may refuse riders over 65 / under 12 (reported); rental closes before the wall.
pitfalls.fix: Walk a section, or rent a tandem; arrive before late afternoon.

pitfalls.title: No fountain show today
pitfalls.situation: Planning the evening around the Big Wild Goose Pagoda fountain.
pitfalls.consequence: Schedules vary; paused in winter and some Tuesday sessions.
pitfalls.fix: Check the day's schedule; Datang Everbright City is next door either way.

pitfalls.title: Show not running
pitfalls.situation: Counting on the Song of Everlasting Sorrow in winter.
pitfalls.consequence: Seasonal schedule; a December pause was announced for 2026.
pitfalls.fix: Check the official Huaqing Palace site for your date; book real-name tickets.

pitfalls.title: 240-hour transit is Shaanxi-only (from XIY)
pitfalls.situation: Entering at Xianyang Airport on visa-free transit and planning other provinces.
pitfalls.consequence: Leaving the permitted area breaks the transit rules.
pitfalls.fix: Check eligibility and the permitted area for your exact route before booking; onward ticket must go to a third country.
pitfalls.verify: Official NIA rules for multi-province routes.
